method: All 19 original screenshot.jpg files were individually returned through tools.view_image with detail original and inspected in this agent turn. No generated contact sheet or screenshot substituted for an original.
Manual screenshot observations are recorded per case. Public DOM and receipts provide identity corroboration and do not substitute for screenshot observation.
All nine actual raw files per case were read, counted and SHA-256 hashed, and matched to raw-final-bindings.json.
Edited annotation expected lines were independently authored and matched to bound browser SVG tspan sequences; screenshots confirm note/two-row presence without certifying every tiny glyph.
limitations: AI screenshot/state consistency audit; no human visual review, aesthetic acceptance, physical-print readability, font-byte/family certification, endpoint proof or native-performance measurement.
CNN L2 is at approximately 17% fit; detailed inner text and line endpoints are below meaningful visual inspection scale.
Header records width choice. Fit-to-viewport paper size is similar for 85/180 mm; physical width is corroborated by document/DOM/receipt, not inferred from pixels.
Canvas response envelope revision is a separate value from document revision. DOM, screen/export receipts and screenshot footer match document revision; both values are retained per case.
Capture timestamps, UA/DPR provenance and history of reopen/save are raw-recorded evidence; this audit does not independently certify original acquisition.
No product code, frozen raw evidence, screenshot, browser state or service state was changed.
